items.title: Show HN: FormatStack – JSON, JSONPath and regex tools that run in the browser
items.desc: description: Free developer utilities that run entirely in your browser: JSON formatter, JSONPath tester, regex tester, UUID generator, Base64 encoder/decoder and cron parser, plus indepth reference guides. Free Developer Utility Tools Fast, free, no signup. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — nothing you paste here ever leaves your machine. 100% clientside no signup no uploads instant results [ JSON Formatter Prettyprint, validate, and minify JSON with syntax highlighting and clear error messages. ](tools/jsonformatter/) [ JSONPath Tester Query and filter JSON with JSONPath. Every match shows the exact path it was found at. ](tools/jsonquery/) [ Regex Tester Test regular expressions with live match highlighting, capture groups, and common presets. ](tools/regextester/) [ UUID Generator Generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 identifiers, one at a time or in batches. ](tools/uuidgenerator/) [ Base64 Encoder / Decoder Encode text to Base64 and decode it back, with full UTF8 support for any language. ](tools/base64encoder/) [ Cron Parser Translate cron expressions into plain English and preview the next scheduled run times. ](tools/cronparser/) Guides Reference material for the things that waste an afternoon. [ Every JSON.parse Error Explained What each message actually means across Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Node — plus the two silent failures that are not errors at all. ](guides/jsonparseerrors/) [ JSONPath Cheatsheet Every operator with worked examples, and the seven places implementations disagree with RFC 9535. ](guides/jsonpathcheatsheet/) [ Base64: The Parts That Bite Why btoa throws on emoji, how base64url differs, and why Node decodes invalid input silently. ](guides/base64gotchas/) [All guides →](guides/) From the blog Build notes and arguments. [All posts →](blog/) 21 September 2026security [Where Developer Data Actually Leaks](blog/wheredeveloperdataleaks/) Production data rarely escapes through a breach. It escapes through pastebins, online formatters, AI chat windows, screenshots and git history. 21 September 2026opinion [ClientSide Tools Are a Security Decision](blog/clientsideisasecuritydecision/) Pasting an API response into an online formatter is a data disclosure, not a convenience — and nothing in the interface tells you so.
items.author: formatstack
items.descZh: 这是一款完全运行在浏览器端的免费开发者工具集，核心理念在于通过 100% 客户端运行保障数据安全，无需注册且绝不上传用户粘贴的任何内容。其核心功能覆盖了 JSON 格式化与 JSONPath 测试、正则表达式实时高亮匹配、加密安全 UUID v4 的批量生成、全 UTF-8 支持的 Base64 编解码，以及将 Cron 表达式转化为通俗英文的解析器。工具集不仅提供即时、无延迟的本地计算反馈，还配套了直击痛点的深度技术指南，帮助开发者解决诸如 JSON.parse 静默失败等跨浏览器兼容难题。产品通过博客文章强化了“将数据粘贴到在线工具即为数据泄露”的安全警示，将使用客户端工具提升为开发者的关键安全决策。该工具集特别适用于处理敏感 API 数据、进行本地脱敏开发，以及所有追求零网络延迟与极高隐私保护的日常技术运维与编码场景。
items.quote: 每个工具都完全在您的浏览器中运行-您在这里粘贴的任何内容都不会离开您的机器。

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity and more, every account you are logged into, side by side. [](/dkremsa/claudepacer/blob/main/docs/icon.png) The rings are the session and the week of whichever tab is open — the Claude login you used last, until you pick another. Each fills to its speed: the projected % at reset if you keep going like this. 100 = you run out exactly at reset. Green ≤ 80, amber ≤ 100, and past 100 the ring becomes a solid red disc. (A tab you are not logged into has no speed: its rings show what was used, on a tighter scale, the way its card does.) No numbers up there. Click it: [](/dkremsa/claudepacer/blob/main/docs/card.png) [](/dkremsa/claudepacer/blob/main/docs/tabs.gif) Click a tab to see that account, and the menu bar follows it — the rings up there and the card always mean the same subscription. Click anywhere else on the card to sample now. What's different Every other menubar tool shows the percent. Pacer shows the speed: where you land at reset if you keep going like this. 16% used sounds fine — until you notice it's 10% into the week. One sentence of advice. Computed from your actual model mix: stop/reduce Fable, move X% of Opus work to Sonnet, or do less. "On pace — nothing to change" when you're fine. Permodel weights measured on your own account. Anthropic doesn't publish how Opus/Sonnet/Fable count against the limits. Pacer joins the official usage % with your local transcripts and fits the weights from the data (and whether cache reads are discounted). Until there's enough data it uses API price ratios. APIequivalent cost over a rolling day, week and 30 days, across every Claude Code profile whose transcripts are in ~/.claude/projects (a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profile counts when its projects is a symlink there), so you know what the subscriptions are worth to you. Notifications when the pace crosses 100, when it comes back, and when any window passes 90%. Every account, remembered. Each subscription seen on the machine keeps its last reading. One you are not logged into shows what was used and "last checked"; when its reset passes, that window drops to 0 and its ring turns green — the cue to switch back. Forgotten after a week unseen. It asks again when a reset is due, instead of waiting for the next 10minute sample. Tiny. One Node script (no dependencies) + one Swift file. The data is a JSON file other tools can read. Install Requires macOS 13+, Node ≥ 18, Xcode Command Line Tools (xcodeselect install), and at least one login from the table below. brew install dkremsa/tap/pacer brew services start pacer samples every 10 min, survives reboots cp R "$(brew prefix)/opt/pacer/Pacer.app" /Applications/ && open "/Applications/Pacer.app" The formula was called claudepacer before v2.0.0\. That name still resolves, but an installed claudepacerdoes not upgrade across the rename — run brew uninstall claudepacer first. Or from source: git clone https://github.com/dkremsa/claudepacer.git ~/.claude/pacer && cd ~/.claude/pacer && ./build.sh — compiles the app into /Applications and installs a launchd agent that samples every 10 minutes. Start at login: System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions → + → pick Pacer from Applications. The sampler already runs at boot; this is for the menubar icon. For other tools ~/.claude/pacer/status.json is refreshed every 10 minutes: pace, level, advice, windows[] (used %, speed, projected, hours left), cost (all transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, rolling day/week/month), fit — the rest for the default Claude Code log
items.author: dkremsa
items.descZh: 在 AI 编码订阅如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等广泛使用的背景下，用户需要一种智能工具来监控额度消耗，避免超支或浪费。claudepacer 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，通过两个环形图实时显示当前会话和本周的使用速度，预测重置时的使用百分比，绿色 ≤80 表示安全，琥珀色 ≤100 需警惕，超过 100 则变为红色实心圆预警。其亮点在于不显示简单百分比，而是计算速度，例如当 16% 使用量看似正常时，可能已消耗周额度的 10%，从而提供如减少 Fable 使用或转移部分 Opus 工作到 Sonnet 的具体优化建议；工具基于用户实际模型混合数据拟合权重，并在使用率超过 90% 或 100% 时发送通知，体积小巧仅由一个 Node 脚本和 Swift 文件构成。适用于需要精细管理多个 AI 编码订阅的开发者或团队，以优化资源分配和成本控制，确保订阅价值最大化。
items.quote: 16%的使用听起来不错-直到你注意到它的10%到一周。

items.title: Show HN: A utility microservice for human trust
items.desc: description: Futex — Multitenant humanintheloop control plane for AI agents. Durable, policydriven human approvals with MCPnative tools. title: Futex — HumanintheLoop Control Plane [Skip to main content](main) RODMEN/A · HITL Control Plane Put humans in the loop/ Futex is a multitenant control plane that lets AI agents request durable, policydriven human decisions — multiapprover, rejectwithreasons, delegation, escalation, expiry, clearance — and resume via webhooks or polling. Nonblocking, MCPnative, and built for scale. [Set Up Your Agent ](/claude) [API Reference](/docs) MCP Native Tools 10+ MCP Tools 0 Blocking Calls Get Started One command to connect Point any MCPcompatible agent at Futex and it gains a full toolkit for requesting and managing human approvals. Free key — no signup, no dashboard futexfreepass@mail.rodmena.co.uk Email this address from any inbox. You'll get a futex_sk_... key back in seconds. Lost it? Email futexfreepass+rotate@mail.rodmena.co.uk for a replacement. Terminal Register the MCP server claude mcp add transport http scope user futexhitl \ https://futex.rodmena.co.uk/mcp/ \ header "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY" Then say: Read https://futex.rodmena.co.uk/claude and set me up to use Futex. Features What Futex does Durable, policydriven human decisions — designed for the agent era. PolicyDriven Approvals Multistage approvals, quorum (nofm), separation of duties, and SLA escalation — all defined per policy, not hardcoded. NonBlocking Architecture Agents request a decision and get an ID back immediately — poll or receive a webhook when a human reviews it. Never block. Human Review Surface Reviewers get an email with a secure link to approve, reject, delegate, or escalate — no dashboard login required. Delegation & Escalation Outofoffice delegation reroutes tasks automatically; SLA breaches trigger escalation to senior reviewers. Durable & Audited Transactional outboxes, idempotent decisions, and every action audited with acting_as and timestamp. MultiTenant Isolation Hard tenant boundaries with keys scoped to tenant plus principal. Failclosed on auth outages — never proceed as approved. Architecture How it works Nonblocking by design. Agents request, humans decide, and the outcome flows back — all durably. Sequence Flow Agent Futex Human Reviewer request\_decision (with idempotency key) decision\_id (immediate, nonblocking) email with secure link approve / reject / delegate (via secure link) webhook: decision.terminal (HMACsigned) or poll get\_decision(id) OUTCOME ENVELOPE approved · rejected · changes\_requested · timed\_out · cancelled Python / httpx Request a decision (nonblocking) dec = api.post("/v1/decisions", json={ "policy_id": "pol_...", "idempotency_key": "deploy1", "title": "Deploy to prod", "proposed_action": {"action": "deploy"}, "context": {"risk": "high"} }).json() Poll until terminal while True: d = api.get(f"/v1/decisions/{dec['id']}").json() if d["status"] in TERMINAL: break time.sleep(5) if d["status"] == "approved": ... proceed else: print(d["feedback_for_agent"]) Nonblocking by Design Creation returns instantly; production agents poll or use webhooks — never wait synchronously for a human. Idempotent The same idempotency_key in a tenant returns the same decision — never doubleasks. FailClosed Auth outages return 503; expiries default to timed_out. Never proceed as if approved on error. MCPNative 10 firstclass tools over Streamable HTTP — agents connect by URL and API key, no SDK or glue code. Documentation Everything you need Full API reference, OpenAPI spec, and system status — all in one place. Ready to put humans in the loop? Set up your agent in minutes. No dashboard login, no onboarding call — just an API key and a policy. items.author: logxroot
items.descZh: 该产品是一个轻量级 AI agent，旨在解决现有 agent 普遍依赖 Node.js 等运行时或特定云服务商的问题。它受 pi agent 启发，在此基础上实现了极致的轻量化，无需任何外部依赖即可运行。其核心亮点在于极小的体积和部署灵活性，能够轻松运行在微型硬件上，甚至直接嵌入到用户自己的二进制程序中。这使得它特别适用于资源受限的边缘计算设备、嵌入式系统以及需要离线或独立运行的场景。

items.desc: I have been working on a classics reading app for iPhone & iPad called Chromatics. The app colors character dialogue and it helps you stay immersed in the story. If you are interested, please try it!
items.author: mchromatics
items.descZh: 该应用名为Chromatics，是一款针对iPhone与iPad开发的经典文学阅读工具，旨在通过视觉设计提升阅读沉浸感。其核心功能是为不同角色的对话自动着色，帮助读者在复杂的人物关系和长篇叙述中快速区分说话者，减少阅读中断。该应用没有提供具体的性能数字，但其亮点在于将色彩编码与经典文本结合，让阅读体验更加直观。它适合正在阅读古希腊、罗马或莎士比亚等人物众多的经典作品的用户，尤其是希望在移动设备上保持专注的读者。

items.descZh: 随着AI辅助编程（Vibe Coding）的普及，如何高效管理人机交互意图成为提升开发效率的关键。ObedienceCorp推出的Festival（Vibe Engineering Framework）旨在通过结构化框架解决AI交互中的意图模糊与token资源浪费问题。其核心功能在于“组织意图（Organize your intent）”与“循环工作（loop your work）”，通过闭环迭代机制帮助开发者精准控制AI行为，确保达成预期产出。项目生态高度模块化，原生集成了对Claude、Cursor等主流编辑器的插件支持（如`.claudeplugin`、`.cursorplugin`），并提供了丰富的模板、技能库及自动化安装器，实现了AI协作的工程化与标准化。通过精细化控制交互流程，该框架能显著降低无效提示词消耗，提升代码生成质量。它非常适合需要严格控制API预算、追求极致效率，并希望建立标准化AI开发流水线的个人开发者与团队。
items.quote: 组织您的意图、循环您的工作并从人工智能中实现您想要的结果，而不浪费代币

View all files Repository files navigation Reflex A GGUFnative Rust and CUDA inference engine built for cold starts: the time from launching a process to its first result, not sustained server throughput. Every CUDA kernel is compiled ahead of time by nvcc and shipped inside the binary, so nothing is JITcompiled when the process starts. \~483 ms cold start, p50: reflex system1 from process start to its scored result (the engine's own timer), Tesla T4, Qwen30.6BQ4_K_M, n=10. Measured from outside the process, including the \~110 ms the OS spends launching it, that is \~0.6 s wall clock. [Phase breakdown](/lateosai/reflex/blob/master/docs/benchmarks.mdcoldstartphasebreakdown). Measured with f32weights, before f16 weight storage became the default. A samesession T4 comparison of the two weight types puts f16 7% faster here, with half the VRAM and 36–42% faster decode ([f16 weight storage](/lateosai/reflex/blob/master/docs/benchmarks.mdf16weightstorage)). Architectural boundary. Reflex is a local execution engine for singletenant decisions: one request at a time, no scheduler, no batching, no network server inside the engine. items.author: leochong
items.descZh: Reflex 是一个专为极低冷启动延迟和实时 System 1 智能体决策循环优化的高性能 GGUF 原生 Rust & CUDA 推理引擎，其设计哲学与传统持续吞吐量服务器不同，专注于单次决策的快速响应。该引擎采用本地执行架构，支持单租户一次一个请求，无调度器、无批处理，网络功能通过独立的 HTTP sidecar 经本地 IPC 实现，确保核心引擎的纯粹与高效。其核心亮点在于所有 CUDA 内核均由 nvcc 提前编译并打包在二进制文件中，消除了启动时的 JIT 编译开销，实现了在 Tesla T4 GPU 上约 483 毫秒（p50）的冷启动延迟，折合墙钟时间约 0.6 秒。性能优化还体现在权重存储上，采用 f16 权重存储相比 f32 可提速 7%，节省一半 VRAM，并带来 36-42% 的解码加速。适用于需要即时响应、对冷启动时间极度敏感的本地 AI 智能体决策场景，如实时交互系统或边缘计算设备。
